description: The tables the 'Direct Message Owner' role holds Read on, at User (Basic) depth, so that Dataverse accepts the memberless 'Spaarke Direct Message Owners' team as the OWNER of an unfiled Direct 1:1 message and of every child row that follows it (fm task 054a: the message and its attachments, participant rows, email review logs, documents and gate Decision Records). The team lives in the Direct-message business unit: a direct child of the root that holds no users, never the root and never Secure Record. The role is created once in the root (Dataverse copies it into every child unit) and the Direct unit's copy is assigned to the Direct team only. The audience of a Direct-team-owned message and its children is exactly its thread's participants, through per-participant Read shares (uac-r2 task 198); the team grants no one anything because it has no members. Dataverse refuses an owner whose roles lack Read on the table ('Read Privilege Check For Owner failed ... is missing prv<Read> privilege'). This file is the ONE list for the Direct team. scripts/Set-CustomerOwnerTeams.ps1 -DirectMessageBusinessUnitName reads it. Do not copy it anywhere else.
howToExtend: The tables are exactly those fm task 054a assigns to the Direct team (confirmed by fm 2026-11-09). Add or remove a table only with fm's writer change.

'privilegeName' is the Read privilege's name from metadata (EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='x')/Privileges, PrivilegeType eq 'Read'). The casing follows the schema name. The script checks it against metadata and refuses a mismatch.
Then run: scripts/Set-CustomerOwnerTeams.ps1 -EnvironmentUrl <url> -DirectMessageBusinessUnitName <name> (dry run), then -Apply (owner go), then -Verify. The script never creates the business unit.

Never add a depth, an access type or a member here. The role grants Read at User (Basic) depth and nothing else; the team has no members, ever, and holds no other role, and the Direct business unit holds no users.
